returns.name: Form IL-941, Illinois Withholding Income Tax Return
contents: Due by the last day of the month after the quarter; filed electronically (waiver by Form IL-900-EW). Illinois has no annual reconciliation return.
Schedule P (Illinois Withholding Schedule) is completed with it; Schedules WC and WC-I report withholding credits.
Filed through MyTax Illinois or the Federal/State Employment Taxes (FSET) program using IDOR-approved software.

Illinois unemployment insurance (Illinois Department of Employment Security): no document read.
Illinois's state-holiday list (weekends only are skipped, with a warning).
W-2 / 1099 filing (Publication 110) and the electronic mandate for them: named in Publication 131, rules not read.
The mid-year switch to semi-weekly after exceeding $12,000 in a quarter.

deposits.interpretation: Illinois assigns a MONTHLY or SEMI-WEEKLY payment schedule from the withholding reported in the look-back period (July 1 to June 30 before the calendar year; for 2026: July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025). First-time taxpayers and those who reported $12,000 or less are MONTHLY; more than $12,000 is SEMI-WEEKLY. An employer who exceeds $12,000 of withholding within a quarter must start paying semi-weekly in the FOLLOWING quarter, for the rest of the year and the next year (that mid-year switch is the employer's to apply and is NOT modelled: supply the assigned frequency). MONTHLY: Form IL-501 payment by the 15th of the month after the month the tax was withheld. SEMI-WEEKLY: by Wednesday for amounts withheld the preceding Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, and by Friday for amounts withheld the preceding Saturday, Sunday, Monday or Tuesday. Illinois files a QUARTERLY return (Form IL-941) for everyone. Liability from two different quarters is paid in two separate payments, each identifying its reporting period: the guide's example is a Wednesday September 30, 2026 payday and a Thursday October 1, 2026 payday, both due Wednesday October 7, 2026, paid separately. A due date on a weekend or state holiday moves to the next business day.

channels.description: MyTax Illinois, the FSET program (IDOR-approved tax-prep software files electronically), and ACH credit payments
enrollment: Register for Illinois Withholding Income Tax; first return options are on Form IL-941 Step 1 or MyTax Illinois sign-up.

To file through software, use a program approved by IDOR under the Federal/State Employment Taxes (FSET) program (software you develop or purchase); to pay, MyTax Illinois, approved software, or the ACH credit option.
